description: Rumour system schema for 2o7. Each rumour is a piece of information circulating through the game world that the player can encounter, spread, or verify.

id.description: Unique rumour identifier, e.g. R01, R02

text.description: The rumour as heard by the player — informal, conversational

text_sw.description: Kiswahili version if the rumour is heard in Kiswahili

truth.description: Actual truth status of the rumour

heat.description: How inflammatory/dangerous the rumour is. 1 = harmless gossip, 5 = could incite violence

reach.description: How widely the rumour has spread

verify_via.description: How the player can check if the rumour is true — a character, an archive card, a location, etc.

network_tags.description: Tags for which social networks/groups the rumour circulates in

source_character.description: Character ID who first tells the player this rumour

first_heard.description: Chapter/scene where the rumour first appears

rumours.text: Free unga at the rally tomorrow. My neighbour's cousin said they're giving out 2kg packets to everyone who shows up.
rumours.text_sw: Unga bure kwa rally kesho. Jirani yangu amesema wanapea kila mtu packet ya kilo mbili.
rumours.verify_via: Ask Mama Achieng' (she supplies provisions) or check the rally flyer at the notice board
